# Mosmos

> 내 AI가 자라는 세계 — A world where my AI grows up. Mosmos is a personal AI:
> tell it a goal, it gets the result, and the more you use it the more it grows
> to feel like you. This site is the prelaunch waitlist (waitlist.mosmos.world).

## Key terms

- Mos — an AI companion that spends time with you, building up your memories,
  tastes, and judgment.
- Mon — a specialist that helps Mos take on the work: researching, doing it, and
  handing back a tidy result.

## Pages

- [Waitlist (KO)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/): join and get invited first.
- [Waitlist (EN)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/en): English version.
- [Waitlist (JA)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/ja): Japanese version.
- [Privacy policy](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/privacy): what we collect and why.

## Notes

- Prelaunch: no launch date is promised. We invite people a few at a time.
- llms.txt is an optional, non-standard hint; crawling permission is governed by robots.txt.
